## Description

Refund full or partial to the original method via provider API (or cash with reason), generating a credit note against the invoice; permissions configurable (e.g. admin approval above a threshold).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** A refund creates a credit note referencing the original invoice number and updates dues/reports.
- [ ] **AC2.** Provider refunds are confirmed by webhook before showing "Refunded"; failures are visible.
- [ ] **AC3.** Refunds above the threshold require admin approval; all refunds are audited.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
